dedupe_keys.name: plateau building and hazard city bundles data v1

description: This GitHub release publishes 29 compressed city/year bundles derived from Japan’s Project PLATEAU building and hazard data. The repository describes a canonical buildings GeoParquet table, FlatGeobuf geometry, PMTiles display tiles, a provenance and coverage manifest, and per-tile attribute files inside each bundle. The data-v1 release API listed 29 named assets when checked. A modeller could query building attributes and flood, tsunami, storm-surge or landslide intersections as scenario inputs, while keeping survey coverage distinct from a recorded zero hazard depth. The included cities span the Tokyo wards and other Japanese municipalities, with source years and hazard coverage varying by city. The release is separate from the MIT-licensed `plateau-bridge` preparation code, which has its own draft record. The project states that PLATEAU source CityGML and its derived bundles are CC BY 4.0 with attribution. This review read documentation and release metadata only. It did not download any archive, verify its SHA-256, inspect a building row or reproduce the hazard intersections. Related resources are the PLATEAU original datasets and the code pipeline.
licence: CC BY 4.0 for PLATEAU-derived data bundles; attribution required.
